net.coobird.thumbnailator.builders.ThumbnailParameterBuilder builder = new net.coobird.thumbnailator.builders.ThumbnailParameterBuilder();
java.util.List<net.coobird.thumbnailator.filters.ImageFilter> myFilters = java.util.Arrays.asList(net.coobird.thumbnailator.filters.Flip.HORIZONTAL);

builder.size(100, 100).filters(myFilters);
net.coobird.thumbnailator.ThumbnailParameter param = builder.build();

java.util.List<net.coobird.thumbnailator.filters.ImageFilter> retrievedFilters = param.getFilters();

assert retrievedFilters != null && retrievedFilters.size() == 1 : "Filters should be set and retrievable";
assert retrievedFilters.get(0) == net.coobird.thumbnailator.filters.Flip.HORIZONTAL : "Filter should match the one set";

System.out.println("__CHECK__ filters " + retrievedFilters.size());
